task.description:
Run docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md's procedure exactly, in full, for this branch. This is WF-03 (issue-resolving), so use commit prefix 'fix' not 'feat' for step 3's finalize commit and the PR title (per GIT_MERGE.md's own note for WF-03 branches). All upstream gates are green: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASSED (after 3 rework cycles -- 2 real OTP-semantics bugs and 1 real race condition, all genuinely fixed and independently re-verified live each time), ELIXIR-DEV implementation PASSED, SECURITY-REVIEWER PASSED (out of scope for tenant-data gates, INV-4/6/7/8 all independently checked clean), REVIEWER PASSED (idiomatic OTP, supervision integrity preserved, no scope creep, decision-record consistent), TEST-DESIGNER/TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASSED (mutation-tested fail-then-pass regression coverage, independently re-verified), TEST-RUNNER PASSED (mix letflow.check.test: 3203+7+11 passed, 0 failures across all 3 phases). ISS-0451 is already marked resolved in docs/issues/ISS-0451.yaml and its GitHub mirror (#865) is already closed with the mandated evidence comment.

Follow every step of GIT_MERGE.md exactly: stage remaining uncommitted files by explicit filename, commit, fetch+rebase onto origin/main (handle any conflict per that doc's guidance -- this branch should rebase cleanly since no other run has touched lib/letflow/application.ex or lib/letflow/supervisor/ concurrently, per this run's own owned_modules lock), re-verify mix format/compile/test after rebase, push (handle the expected non-fast-forward-after-rebase case per that doc's own note), open the PR with title prefix 'fix:' and the full validation summary in the body (mix compile PASS, mix test counts with 0 failures -- no attribution parenthetical needed since there were none, SECURITY-REVIEWER PASS with the out-of-scope reasoning, RELEASE-VALIDATOR line: N/A for WF-03, omit or note 'not part of WF-03'), wait for CI (backend + frontend jobs) to report green -- attribute any failure structurally per core-directives.md, never by count-matching -- then merge with --squash --delete-branch, and do the mandatory local cleanup (checkout main, pull --ff-only, delete local branch, verify clean).
acceptance_criteria: Branch rebased cleanly onto origin/main (or conflict resolved per GIT_MERGE.md's guidance)
mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test all re-verified post-rebase
PR opened with title prefix 'fix:', full validation summary in the body per GIT_MERGE.md step 7
CI backend + frontend jobs confirmed green (or failures structurally attributed) before merging
Local cleanup verified: on main, pulled, clean working tree, log shows the squash-merge commit

result.summary: Rebased fix/ISS-0451-persistent-poller-crash-budget-20260904 cleanly onto origin/main (58 commits replayed, no conflicts). Post-rebase re-verification: mix format --check-formatted PASS, mix compile --warnings-as-errors PASS, mix test (full suite) 3198/3204 passed / 6 failed / 21 excluded -- all 6 failures isolated to Letflow.ServiceCatalogTest (undefined_table: process_definitions does not exist), a module/test file this branch's diff never touches; re-ran that file alone immediately after and got 33/33 passed, 0 failures, confirming the failures were transient shared-checkout contamination (a concurrent unrelated session was independently observed running `mix test test/m0427_probe_test.exs`, PIDs 28964/34312, against the same shared Postgres instance during verification). Force-pushed (--force-with-lease, own branch only, expected non-fast-forward after rebase) and opened PR #874. CI: frontend gate passed on both triggered runs; backend gate passed cleanly on the pull_request-event run (33840208029, commit f7858821) but failed on the push-event run (33840184735, same commit f7858821, confirmed via `gh run view --json headSha` on both) inside the isolated wasm_hang phase -- two timing-sensitive tests (plugin_handler_test.exs REQ-170 AC4 wall-clock-ordering assertion; host_api_write_test.exs hitting the full 180s ExUnit timeout) alongside unrelated concurrent Keycloak econnrefused noise, with zero diff overlap in lib/letflow/engine/wasm|lua and matching this repo's already-documented recurring 'wasm_hang timing assertion flakes under CI runner contention' class (ISS-0418, ISS-0453). Attribution route: known recurring flake class + zero diff overlap + the identical commit passing cleanly on the concurrent job. Reported the new flake instance to ORCH for queue registration (per ISSUE_QUEUE.md, id allocation belongs to letflow-queue via ORCH's register_task, not self-assigned by ELIXIR-DEV) rather than filing a locally-numbered docs/issues/ record myself. Merged PR #874 via gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch (merge commit 77fe6bf44c184bb8caef287c9df0da00a6c4dc05). Local cleanup: gh's merge side effect already left the checkout on main, fast-forwarded to the merge commit; git fetch --prune removed the stale remote-tracking ref; verified branch --show-current=main, log shows the squash-merge commit at HEAD, status clean, remote branch confirmed deleted (git ls-remote --heads origin returns nothing for it).
artifacts_out: branch: fix/ISS-0451-persistent-poller-crash-budget-20260904 (squash-merged into main as 77fe6bf4, branch deleted both locally and on origin)

issues.description: New flaky-CI instance found during this step's CI wait, not caused by this branch: PR #874's push-event backend-gate run (33840184735, job 100920721979) failed the isolated wasm_hang phase on test/letflow/engine/wasm/plugin_handler_test.exs:474 (REQ-170 AC4 wall-clock-ordering assertion, both measured elapsed times pinned at 30000ms) and test/letflow/engine/wasm/host_api_write_test.exs:460 (ExUnit.TimeoutError after 180000ms in start_instance/2), with concurrent unrelated 'Metadata load failed for issuer http://localhost:8082/realms/bpm-default ... econnrefused' Keycloak noise throughout the same window -- consistent with CI runner resource contention, not a logic defect. The identical commit (f7858821) passed the entire backend gate cleanly on the pull_request-event run (33840208029). Branch diff touches zero files under lib/letflow/engine/wasm/, test/letflow/engine/wasm/, or lib/letflow/engine/lua/ (git diff origin/main --stat over those paths returns empty). Matches this repo's already-tracked recurring class (see ISS-0418, ISS-0453 -- both note the wasm_hang family and wall-clock-ordering assertions are contention-sensitive under CI load). Not filed as docs/issues/ISS-NNNN.yaml by this agent per ISSUE_QUEUE.md step 2's division of labor (id allocation is letflow-queue's via ORCH's register_task; the discovering agent reports to ORCH rather than self-numbering or calling gh directly). ORCH should register this via register_task and file the local record once allocated, folding it into whatever resolves ISS-0418/ISS-0453's shared wasm_hang-timing-flake question per that issue's own note against deciding it a third time independently.

result.next_action: ORCH marks run WF03-ISS0451-20260904 COMPLETED, releases the owned_modules lock on lib/letflow/application.ex and lib/letflow/supervisor/, and registers the wasm_hang flake instance noted in result.issues via letflow-queue's register_task before filing docs/issues/ISS-NNNN.yaml for it.
